SLI, SLO, SLA and Error Budgets

An SLI is a measurement, an SLO is a target, and an SLA is a service agreement; an error budget is
allowed unreliability under an SLO.
SLI කියන්Jන් measure කරන value එක. SLO කියන්Jන් target එක. SLA එක customer
agreement එකක්. Error budget එක SLO තුළ ඉඩ Jදන failures ප්‍රමාණය.
For a 99.9% success SLO over 10,000 eligible requests, budget is 10 failures.

# Example: 10,000 requests
SLO success = 99.9%
Allowed failures = 10
